svg.title: Page table mapping from the slide: n=2, m=4, 4-byte pages, 32-byte physical memory
svg.desc: Logical pages 0-3 mapped via page table to physical frames 5, 6, 1, 2 respectively, showing data letters a-p redistributed in physical memory.
svg.text: Physical address = PFN × 4 + offset | e.g. logical 9 → VPN=2, offset=1 → frame 1 → phys = 1×4+1 = 5 → byte "j"
